text:
Laura: FYI the embed-ops-error alert started spiking during today's batch run — ~400 firings over the last 6h. It's drowning out other alerts, can we tune it so oncall isn't paged for the nightly batch noise? Link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/embed-api?panel=errors
SREBot: Alertmanager: 392 occurrences of embed-ops-error in last 6h. severity=critical :rotating_light:
Ishaan: Where do you want us to look first — logs, traces, or the error-rate panel? Is this causing customer impact or just internal batch noise?
Laura: Mostly internal. Users not impacted AFAICT. Start with grafana panel + logs. Kibana query: `service:embed-api AND level:error AND timestamp:>=now-6h`
Maya: Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abcd/embed-api-errors. For traces check Tempo: https://tempo.internal/trace-search?service=embed-api
Ben: Quick thought: a lot of these have label `job=nightly-batcher`. If that's true we should either exclude that job from the alert or raise the threshold during the 02:00-05:00 UTC window.
Ishaan: Agreed. Two options: 1) change the Prometheus expr to ignore `job="nightly-batcher"`, or 2) add a silence/mute window in Alertmanager for that window. Prefer #1 unless we expect real regressions during the batch.
Maya: I can open PR. Proposed alert rule tweak:
```
ALERT EmbedOpsError
IF sum by(instance) (rate(embed_api_errors_total{job!="nightly-batcher"}[5m])) > 10
FOR 15m
LABELS { severity="warning" }
```
That will keep it from firing on the batch and relax to warning.
Ben: Also add a runbook link and update the dashboard to show `job` breakdown so we can see immediately if it's batch-only.
Laura: OK sounds good. @Maya please include runbook link `/runbooks/embed-ops` in the label and cc eng-oncall in the PR. If you want a temporary silence instead, ask me and I'll approve a 3h silence for tonight.
Maya: Will do, opening PR now and adding tests for the alert expression + dashboard panel notes. ETA ~1h.
Ishaan: After PR, can someone post the alert rule snippet into the alerts repo and ping ops for deploy? I'll watch for any regressions.
SREBot: Note: created incident annotation for this thread `embed-alert-noise-2026-03-17`
Laura: Thanks all :thumbsup: We'll re-evaluate in the morning and close if noise drops.
